summary: Independent check of the library and page repairs. Fixed: speech struck (Whisper on all 11 n_ files: one-word artefacts only), attacks (t90 within 1.5 ms for 28 of 29 one-shots), loop seams (all 4 loops tile without a step), bed levels, honest gain numbers, ratings guard (refuses before sending, hash unchanged), detector controls. Not fixed: the full audition check FAILS (50 passed, 1 failed) because the page still clicks at engine group start (9 page faults in the scenes) and loops ground_scrape_loop / dust_patter_loop show 9 more; k_door_close_1 still loses its loudest part to the fade-out. Ratings file hash b3e2ae5c...4cf3 identical before and after every run.

perFinding.evidence: No n_quindar in selection.json, downloads.json entries/sources or the rendered folder; both appear only in notTaken and in the struck list of CREDITS.md; every remaining NASA entry has speech none; fetch.py --check: 25 entries, 0 problems. Whisper (lock) on 11 n_ files: cassini_saturn_1 'Oh', dinks_donks 'you', emfisis_chorus 'you', ingenuity 'you', insight_arm 'you', juno_ganymede 'you', laser_shots 'you', plasma_hiss 'So', rover_driving 'I', sls_test_fire 'you', voyager_lightning 'you'. Limit: Whisper-small only reads words; it does not prove nobody speaks.

29 one-shots: envelope t90 (1 ms smoothed) processed minus source is 0.0 or 1.5 ms (the lead-in) for 28, 0.54 ms for k_tick_2; first sample at most -73.4 dBFS, last at most -90.3 dBFS; for the 11 peak-set one-shots the gain measured by least squares equals target minus source true peak to 0.01 dB. FAIL: k_door_close_1: source envelope rises to its very end (peak at 517.7 ms of 528.6), the 30 ms fade-out cuts it, t90 differs by -18.04 ms, envelope max is 3.09 dB lower, applied gain -10.65 dB against -14.09 dB for the unprocessed source (+3.44 dB). The manifest also says fadeOutMs 30 for k_tick_2 whose file is 25 ms (the code uses n/2).

Tiled 3 times: join step / 99.9th percentile of internal steps = 0.05 (cassini_saturn_1), 0.18 (plasma_hiss), 0.30 (rover_driving), 0.68 (ingenuity); join step 0.0005 to 0.0028, largest internal 0.017 to 0.052; manifest loop check passes for all 4 (seamRatio 0.06, 0.61, 0.69, 0.71). Remaining: n_ingenuity (steady 84 Hz tone) has a 5 dB dip in 50 ms RMS inside its 300 ms crossfade zone (-31 to -32.6 dB against -28.4..-27.1 dB elsewhere), once per 9.7 s: a periodic level pulse, caused by the equal-power crossfade of two phase-mismatched segments of the same tone.

No event at bed level: cabin long one-shots measure -32.0 LUFS (k_computer_noise_1 true peak -24.33, n_dinks_donks -10.40), only loops use -45 and no download loop does. No file above -1 dBFS true peak (highest n_laser_shots -1.05, then n_rover_driving -2.41). Peak-set files measure their target within 0.0 dB; LUFS-set within 0.0 except k_hit_lowboom_0 (-25.45 against -26, 0.55 dB) and n_laser_shots. n_laser_shots: manifest gainDb 11.45, requestedGainDb 20.0, limited true; the file stays at -35.55 LUFS (8.55 dB under its -27 target) with peak -1.05, so it is still a few snaps over a quiet floor (content, not fixable by level). n_sls_test_fire is still in the library with 1362 source-clipped samples and manifest pass false.

Own vite server on port 5471 started WITHOUT AUDITION_RATINGS_FILE; the check run with the variable set to a scratch file printed that the server writes the owner's file and exited 2 with 'Nothing was sent'; owner hash b3e2ae5cf8f41f7ff93738b999edf7745d115032d5e42d30ae884ba557914cf3 identical before and after. Normal case (server and check on the same scratch file) ran to the end; hash identical afterwards. Both servers stopped.

Imported the real analyseChannel from capture.ts in a scratch node script. -40 dBFS step into 440 Hz tone at -50 dBFS: found at 1.0000 s, ratio 55.9 (a single-sample -40 dBFS spike also found). Gaussian noise at -12 dBFS RMS: clean 0 clicks; click 12 dB above the noise's 99.9th percentile step (4.74) found, ratio 3.5; 12 dB above its largest step found, ratio 5.3; BUT a click 12 dB above the noise RMS (a full-scale step, 1.0) NOT found, and in uniform noise at -12 dBFS peak steps of 0.3 to 1.0 NOT found (ratio about 2.2 against the limit of 3). Needs a step above 3 times the 99.9th percentile of steps, so in Gaussian noise louder than about -16 dBFS RMS no click that fits under full scale can be seen. Clean controls (1 kHz sine at -6, noise, exponential attack): none. Also the attribution to 'file' accepts a page click up to 4 times stronger than a loose file step (FILE_RATIO_SLACK 4).

Own server port 5471 and scratch ratings file, through the lock: 50 passed, 1 failed. The failed step is 'capture: no click and no clipped sample comes from the page': 18 page faults, 698 faults in all, 680 in sound files, 0 clipped samples. Page faults: engine group start in the scenes (docking 0.125 s x2, combat 0.107 s x2 and 2.128 s, landing 0.115 s x2, size 0.009 to 0.014, ratio 5.7 to 18.8, sounds engine_main_t000..boost) and landing 0.145 s x2 with size 0.172 and 0.073 (ratio 88.5 and 30.6, sounds include cabin_ambience_loop and cruise_loop, about -15 dBFS), plus library plays ground_scrape_loop (7 faults at 5.37 to 6.03 s, size 0.014 to 0.032) and dust_patter_loop (2 at 5.72 s). The earlier steps 'room is audible' and 'chain honours the cue' passed in this run. File faults by sound id (library plays, 353): pilot_gear_a 68, pilot_gear_c 48, fold_exit 40, pilot_shield_b 30, n_laser_shots 30, impact_shield_heavy 28, fold_jump 24, k_computer_noise_1 17, pilot_shield_a 16, pilot_hull_b 9, impact_shield_medium 9, ground_scrape_loop 7, impact_shield_light 6, debris_patter 4, pilot_hull_a 3, touchdown_hard 2, sensor_fire_outside 2, pilot_thruster_c 2, pilot_thruster_a 2, dust_patter_loop 2, test_step 4 (control). Scene runs add 327 more attributed to files (combat 71, fold 243, landing 13).
